name: Lillie Roberts
role: Young woman of the Medora area
bio: Miss Lillie Roberts spent fall 1885 as a guest in the area and visited Medora in February 1886. In December 1886 the paper reported her marriage to Riley Brooks, then retracted it as untrue and apologized to her.

moments.label: Paper apologized for a false marriage report

mentions: Miss Lillie Roberts is spending the fall with Mrs. J. L. Roberts.
Miss Lillie Roberts spent several days of last week in Medora.

Our congratulations last week on the marriage or approaching marriage of Riley Brooks and Miss Lilly Roberts, were not premature. They were married in Dickinson last Wednesday and for the present at least, will reside in Medora.
